foundationalWork.title: R4 Safety Guardrail wired into the agent boundary
foundationalWork.detail: validateAssistantOutput() + presentToAgent() — the only sanctioned path from assistant output to a support agent. Fails closed; blocks anything that skips human approval or claims to have already acted.

storyVerifications.item: Every tab reachable and every card drills down one level
Sample data is visibly labelled as sample
Data comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime
.colaberry/manifest.json is shown with a data-age warning
No tab shows a number/connection/result the project hasn't actually produced
